It refers to charity","mentions":[]},{"verses":["30:39"],"words":["*"],"type":"interpretation","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"The verse contrasts the prior call to give: interest-based lending extracts from others and does not grow with God, whereas wealth spent to please God does.","anchor":"Only that wealth increases with God which is spent in His way to please Him","mentions":[]},{"verses":["30:39"],"words":["*"],"type":"interpretation","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"Islahi likens interest wealth to an ox fattened by grazing on others’ land; it lacks blessing, unlike earnings from one’s own field spent to fulfill rights and please God.","anchor":"God has compared the wealth of an interest-charger to an ox that grows fat by grazing on the lands of others","mentions":[]},{"verses":["30:39"],"words":["*"],"type":"interpretation","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"The rate at which wealth given in God’s way increases is detailed elsewhere in the Qur’an.","anchor":"The rate of this increase has been mentioned in detail at another instance in the Qur’ān","mentions":[]},{"verses":["30:39"],"words":["*"],"type":"interpretation","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"Fear of the future drives wealth accumulation, but people see only their worldly future and miss the Hereafter; investing with God secures wealth for eternal life.","anchor":"He is not able to see the real future which is the Hereafter","mentions":[]},{"verses":["30:39"],"words":["*"],"type":"interpretation","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"Permissible business capital grows within its own risky investment, whereas a moneylender hides like an ambush and profitably draws from the needy without taking risks.","anchor":"the capital of a tradesman or a businessman after braving many dangers and different circumstances increases from its own circle of investment","mentions":[]}]}
